proposed_capability: A bounded, observation-driven purchase-dialog planner for heterogeneous Sims 4 catalog menus with dynamic scrollbar traversal, per-row quantity reconciliation, safe budget authorizations, activity triggers and per-portrait inventory scope. Extend existing computer purchase and CooperativeScreenQueue ownership; no desktop clicker or native-gameplay effect claim.
operator_correction: Seven supplied paused Sims 4 screenshots show basic/advanced apothecary ingredient catalogs, oversized crop seed catalog, medicine with owned count, nectar machine options and computer Order domains. The full advanced ingredient list is not visible on one screen; the user wants naturally triggered household purchases across menus and portraits without repetitive item clicks.
repository_situation: The existing computer_upgrade_parts.py owns an observed five-part, fixed-row cart; upgrade_parts_force.py covers parts and acquisition paths; workflow_interop.py owns cooperative player-first queue. Missing is a generic paginated picker representation usable across contexts. BI-002 game proof remains separate.

competing_theses.thesis: Hardcode every Sims menu and scroll coordinate
competing_theses.falsification: DLC, patches, scrolling and UI scale invalidate static positions

competing_theses.thesis: Use a universal OS click-spam agent
competing_theses.falsification: Violates player sovereignty, patch-specific game authority, and action verification

competing_theses.thesis: Purchase the entire menu up to maximum quantity by default
competing_theses.evidence: User requests to exhaust scroll list
competing_theses.falsification: Discovery is not spending approval and unnecessary costs damage household goals

competing_theses.thesis: Add observed-page catalog discovery and goal-to-cart engine adjacent to existing computer queue owner
competing_theses.evidence: Existing one-effect-per-revision queue and spending guards can be reused
competing_theses.falsification: Reject if overlapping pages can cause skipped items, repeat actions, or unbounded spending

selected_thesis: Observed-page, bounded dialog catalog traversal and request-scoped purchase proposal; fresh human-first stage guard; per-Sim inventory and household economic evidence.

p82_experiment_admission.hypothesis: Any observed menu shape, including virtualized scrollable lists and one-row pickers, can be discovered without skipping or buying unrequested items; each effect is gated on fresh page/actor identity and no unobserved retry.
p82_experiment_admission.baseline: Fixed five-row Purchase Upgrade Parts batch planner only.
p82_experiment_admission.comparator: Generic dialog catalog discovery followed by exact item/demand cart planner.
measurements: unique rows discovered over overlapping pages
one effect proposal for each fresh revision
no cart mutation without complete catalog and approved cap
p82_experiment_admission.decision_rule: PROMOTE for offline planner only after adversarial tests; P08 remains blocked until local Sims game host; do not claim native game effect.

player_save_control_impact: No game/OS input, no save access, no unapproved spending, no autonomous loop. Future adapter must pass existing CooperativeScreenQueue fresh dual probes and observed effect controls.
negative_tests: overlapping pages and absent bottom evidence
page signature cycle or non-progress scroll
rollback_path: Revert feature branch PR; no game installation or saves affected.
next_gate: Implement generic menu catalog and action planner, tests, and native successor mapping. Source-prove EA hooks and actual local game trials under #171.
